blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. and Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) Chief of Staff Gen. Antonio Nafarrete rushed to Basilan on Tuesday to map out security measures and check on wounded troops following a military convoy ambush in Tipo-Tipo on Monday. Teodoro and Nafarrete convened a security conference with local leaders, led by Basilan Gov. Mujiv Hataman, at the headquarters of the 1101st Infantry Brigade in Barangay Tabiawan, Isabela City. They assessed the situation and discussed measures to address lawless elements and the activities that sustain them, as well as broader security and law […]...
